Description
Card

Dealer<T extends View>
 
Deck
 
Game<T extends View>
This class contains all game logic: dealing cards, checking Black Jacks, playing, checking victory conditions and displaying game state in view.
Main
Only creates basic instances and calls game starting method.
Player<T extends View>
Implements common methods for User and Dealer.
SuitCode
Elements of this enum class represent all possible card suits.
SuitRep
Contains string representations for all possible card suits.
User<T extends View>
Unlike Dealer, this class waits for user to make a decision when playing.
View
Declares actions that internal game logic can signal to UI (Dealer card draws and reveals, game start and end, victory, etc.) and user actions that UI can signal to game logic (user's decision to stop taking cards).
